headline: Anthropic announces transfer of Agent Skills stewardship to the Agentic AI Foundation
summary: Anthropic announced that it is donating the Agent Skills name and logo, GitHub organization and agentskills.io domain to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), which it describes as a neutral home for the standard. It says engineers from Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and other companies will maintain the standard as individuals, and proposes a roadmap for versioned releases, formal proposals and security guidance. These are statements in Anthropic’s announcement; the proposed processes and governance outcomes are not yet demonstrated. Anthropic also reports adoption figures that have not been independently verified.
